output_list.criticism: The function buyTokens is intended to buy tokens for the msg.sender. The variable boughtTokens is calculated by dividing the msg.value by pricePerToken. If pricePerToken is set to a low value, then boughtTokens can be calculated to be greater than the total supply of tokens. This would allow the attacker to buy more tokens than the total supply of tokens. The attacker can then use these tokens to attack other vulnerabilities in the smart contract.
